title: Quake and Quiver, Bow!
description: Retexture of QuiverBow which makes its models look a bit more uh... polished?
body:
QuiverBow! What a delighful little thing of a mod! So many interesting guns and crossbows! Wouldn't it be nice if its models had better textures?

Well uh... this exists now, I guess.

This resourcepack retextures the models of QuiverBow to make them a little less... flat.

Currently done are:
- Coin Tosser
- Modified Coin Tosser
- Lapis Coil
- Redstone Sprayer



...

_does anyone even care about quiverbow at this point_
